name: Enchanting the Girl
source:
Lesbian witches enchant a girl. 

...or do they?

You watch, incorporeal in the shadows, as the two witches try to gain more power by using their magic on a girl. Is the girl more than she first appears? You are also a powerful witch and it seems that you can influence events. Maybe there is even a way for you to be brought back into reality.

[From [url=https://leafletgames.itch.io/enchanting-the-girl]Itch.io[/url]]
